description: This file contains the implementation of a thread-unsafe, capacity-limited queue called DefaultEvictingQueue, which evicts elements when at capacity. It extends AbstractQueue and implements EvictingQueue, providing methods for offering, polling, peeking, and managing the queue elements.

classes.name: DefaultEvictingQueue
classes.description: A capacity-limited, non-thread-safe queue implementation with eviction policy when full.

methods.name: withCapacity
methods.description: Factory method to create a new DefaultEvictingQueue with specified capacity.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the elements in the queue.

methods.name: offer
methods.description: Inserts an element into the queue, evicting the oldest element if at capacity.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Removes and returns the head of the queue.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the head of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on capacity and elements.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on capacity and elements.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the queue.
